parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use the correct double-angle formula to obtain an equation in $\cos\theta$, for example $3(2\cos^2\theta-1)=3\cos\theta+2$. M1. Obtain $6\cos^2\theta-3\cos\theta-5=0$, or equivalent. A1; M1 A0 if a correct double-angle formula is followed by an error. Solve the three-term quadratic in $\cos\theta$. M1; as far as $\theta=\cos^{-1}((3-\sqrt{129})/12)$ if correct. Obtain $134.1^\circ$. A1; accept greater accuracy. Obtain $225.9^\circ$ and no other answers in $[0^\circ,360^\circ]$. A1 FT on $360^\circ$ minus the first answer; radians are a misread; ignore values outside the interval. The printed special ruling covers legitimate four-solution outcomes from an incorrect quadratic and limits marks for extra/missing solutions. Total 5.
